case.title: Pump housing PH-100: the foundry wants +8.8 %
case.briefing: Demo Gießerei GmbH, our single source for the grey-iron pump housing PH-100 for 12 years, announces +8.8 % from 1 December citing energy and wages. Castings are a strategic category: the goal is to stabilise supply with a healthy partner, so squeezing the foundry below a 4 % margin costs us (from EUR 5,000 per margin point and year). We need 4,000 housings a year for the next two years; anything not covered by this deal costs EUR 55.00 per unit (spot buys and a second source). Price, payment terms, contract length and the date the new price applies are open; lead time and Incoterm are fixed.

messages.subject: Quote from Demo Gießerei GmbH: Pump housing PH-100: the foundry wants +8.8 %
messages.body:
Guten Tag,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

It is always a pleasure to work with your esteemed house, continuing the strong tradition of craftsmanship and trust between our companies. For this agreement, our offer stands at a price of €52.90 per unit, a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, valid from 1 December 2026. 

To remain transparent about our situation, WAGES-METAL rose 3.1 % in twelve months and is 28 % of our cost. We take great pride in the dedication of our foundry workforce and the quality we deliver to our partners every day.

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days. We look forward to continuing our successful cooperation together.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Demo Gießerei GmbH: Pump housing PH-100: the foundry wants +8.8 %
messages.body:
Dear Mr Moser,

Thank you for your offer and for your openness about wage costs at the foundry. We value your team's work and the quality you deliver, and we take the rise in metalworkers' wages seriously.

At the same time, the increase you propose is more than we can accept for the PH-100 housing. We have put together options that reflect your wage costs while keeping the price workable for us:

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 46.80; payment 60 days net; contract term 12 months; new price valid from 2026-12-01.
Option B: unit price EUR 45.43; payment 45 days net; contract term 12 months; new price valid from 2026-12-01.
Option C: unit price EUR 46.49; payment 30 days net; contract term 12 months; new price valid from 2026-12-01.

Option C keeps your current payment terms unchanged, if that suits you best. We look forward to your view.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Demo Gießerei GmbH: Pump housing PH-100: the foundry wants +8.8 %
messages.body:
Guten Tag,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We appreciate your understanding of our wage cost situation and your prompt response. However, your proposed prices do not reflect our realities; please share the calculations you used to arrive at these figures. Our price reflects our costs; our calculation stays internal.

To show our commitment to our long-standing partnership, we are prepared to offer €51.90 for Option C, keeping the payment terms at 30 days. Specifically, our current offer stands at a price of €51.90 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, valid from 1 December 2026. This offer stays valid for 30 days.

We value the connection between our businesses and look forward to continuing our work together.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH
